content.study: Corporate governance framework. Governance duties are spread across board composition (s. 149), committees (ss 177-178), directors' duties (s. 166), accounts and audit (Chapter X), and CSR (s. 135), with LODR for listed companies. The section applies only to the persons, companies, and transactions it names. A filing, approval, or penalty arises only where the section or a rule under it says so. It does not create a power that is reserved to another section or to the Tribunal. Not a verified closure.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: Treat the Act as the baseline and LODR as additional for listed entities. Independent directors, audit committee, vigil mechanism, related-party approval and board evaluation are the core levers. Governance guidance that contradicts a section is not law.
